newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Group forms for SM International US$100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for SM International US$100 mln FRN.

text.p: SM International Ltd's US$100 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, joint lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Friday.
The deal is guaranteed by SM International Corp, the parent company of SM Prime.
The facility is due on November 14, 2002. It was priced at par to float at 100 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is about 105.5 basis points.
Joint-lead managers are Merrill Lynch Far East, with US$17.5 million, and LTCB Asia, with US$17 million.
Senior co-lead managers are Development Bank of Singapore, with US$9.5 million, and DKB Asia, with US$8 million.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Banco Santander Philippines, Bank of Nova Scotia Asia, BNP Manila, Credit Lyonnais, DCB Labuan and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson.

Co-managers, with US$3 million each, are Bankers Trust International Asia, E. Sun Commercial Bank Offshore Banking Branch, J.P. Morgan Securities, Maybank New York, Nomura International Hong Kong and Taiwan Cooperative Bank Offshore Banking Branch.
